# Vitalii Yehorov

> Engineering Manager at ToolSense in Vienna, Austria. 15+ years in software, ex-founder, ex-CTO, hands-on TypeScript engineer who leads a product engineering team and runs a multi-provider fleet of AI coding agents.

## Profile

- Role: Engineering Manager, ToolSense (https://toolsense.io), B2B SaaS asset operations platform, since 2023
- Previously: CTO at OnTheWay (2021-2023), VP of Engineering at Clearmove (2019-2021), CTO at Omnivalor (2017-2019), Founder and CEO of SamsonOS (2010-2017)
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, React Native, Next.js, Go, CI/CD, monorepos, microservices
- Languages: English, Ukrainian, German
- Location: Vienna, Austria

## How he works with AI agents

One orchestrator session plans each task and delegates narrow briefs to parallel agents across model families (Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek and others). A multi-model council reviews every change before merge, UI changes are kept only if they win a blind before/after vote, one session owns one pull request until it merges, and checks are never weakened for speed.

## Numbers (as of Nov 2026)

- GitHub, last 12 months: 35,058 contributions, 16,715 commits, 2,301 pull requests
- 3,727 agent sessions orchestrated on a fleet of 5 machines
- 26 open-source npm packages (rnw-community), the largest at about 325k downloads a month

- [rnw-community](https://github.com/rnw-community/rnw-community): 26 npm packages for NestJS, React Native and ESLint
- [Tart Runner Fleet](https://github.com/vitalyiegorov/tart-runner-fleet): fail-closed GitHub Actions runner control plane for Apple-silicon Macs, Go
- [Analyze Your Knee](https://analyzeyourknee.com): knee MRI and X-ray analysis with a multi-model LLM consensus read
- Upstream contributions to t3code, simlock, agent-device and simslim
